title: What's new: Add existing table fields to pages (2023 release wave 2)

Testing in sandbox and importing to production
Safety mechanisms: permissions and developer controls
Caveats and limitations of the feature

features.name: Add existing table fields to pages
features.description: Capability to add any fields from the source table to a page, not just recommended fields. Allows consultants, administrators, and users to customize existing pages without code by selecting fields from the entire table. Added fields appear as read-only.
features.status_evidence_quote: we are launching this capability in preview with update 23
caveats: Only available in role customization, not personalization
Cannot unlock fields that developers intentionally locked for data integrity
May require page refresh to load data in some cases
Not available organization-wide, limited to individual roles
Flow fields can impact performance if many are added
Field will not show if source table field is removed in future

features.name: Enhanced field discovery with tooltips
features.description: New tooltips show field caption, data type, alternate names, whether field is visible on page, and where the field originates from. Helps users understand field context when customizing pages.
caveats: Applies to personalization, role customization, and extension designer

features.name: Advanced filtering for field selection
features.description: Filter controls to find fields more efficiently when working with large tables having 100+ or 200+ fields. Filters include table binding, page controls, base objects vs extensions, and visibility. New advanced filter option displays fields not on the page object.
caveats: Helpful for large tables but may be complex for simple pages
Only available during role customization, not for personal personalization

features.name: Lock and unlock field editability
features.description: Ability to make table fields read-only on pages by locking editing. Prevents accidental data entry and creates visual focus on editable fields. Can only unlock fields that developers have not locked for data integrity.
caveats: Cannot unlock fields developers intentionally locked to preserve data integrity
Only available for fields already added to page

features.name: Drag and drop field placement
features.description: Users can drag and drop fields to place them in custom locations on pages, rather than only the developer-recommended position. Shows visual hint of drop location.
caveats: Works in personalization and role customization

features.name: Persistent search and filter state
features.description: Business Central preserves search terms and filter selections when navigating between pages, allowing users to continue similar customizations across multiple pages without re-entering filters.

features.name: Field data masking for extended data types
features.description: When adding table fields to pages, data is masked for extended data types like passwords. The field value will be masked in both the page inspector and the added field on the page.

features.name: Add table field to page permission
features.description: New permission called add table field to page in the D365 Profile Management permission set. Administrators must grant this permission before users can add table fields to pages via customization.

features.name: Allow customizations property on table fields
features.description: New table field property that developers can set to never or always to control whether the field can be added to pages via customization. Setting to never removes the field from the customization interface.
caveats: Developer setting changes apply instantly in the UI
If set to never after field was added, the field is removed from UI

features.name: Sandbox testing and production import of role customizations
features.description: Administrators can test role customizations in a sandbox environment and then export and import them to production at the appropriate time. Provides safety mechanism to validate changes before deployment.

features.name: Page customizations in AL
features.description: Developers can use page customizations AL implementation to add table fields and groups to pages. Recommended for simple scenarios where no additional functionality or code is needed.
caveats: Page extensions still recommended for scenarios requiring functionality and code
Limited to adding fields as read-only without additional behavior

features.name: Explore in Visual Studio Code
features.description: Page inspection tool that provisions Visual Studio Code with all extensions contributing to a page. Allows inspection of source code to determine if a page has specific functionality not available on the table field.
caveats: Requires Visual Studio Code to be installed
Useful mainly for consultants and developers who can read code

features.name: Page customizations troubleshooting page
features.description: Utility page that shows issues with page customizations. Administrators can use this to diagnose problems and rectify issues with fields that have been added to pages.

features.name: Analysis views for custom data insights
features.description: Capability to get custom data insights using analysis views.
